message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reposition for a later attack on the sole active opponent by replacing its fast, level eastbound transit with a sustained left turn and slight descent, which sharply reduces its north-south offset from B0100 while preserving a large altitude advantage and its remaining missile.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to complicate an intercept by the B0100-launched missile behind it, using repeated hard banking, a net turn north, and sustained descent while preserving speed; the missile remains near its altitude and closes in both longitudinal and lateral separation throughout the window."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reposition for a later attack on the sole active opponent by replacing its fast, level eastbound transit with a sustained left turn and slight descent, which sharply reduces its north-south offset from B0100 while preserving a large altitude advantage and its remaining missile.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to complicate an intercept by the B0100-launched missile behind it, using repeated hard banking, a net turn north, and sustained descent while preserving speed; the missile remains near its altitude and closes in both longitudinal and lateral separation throughout the window.
